mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with FEDFUNDS below 4.5%, or the response of S&P 500 returns to FEDFUNDS changes is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with low unemployment, or the correlation between unemployment and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong supply chain, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong industrial production growth, or the correlation between industrial production and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts and a low unemployment rate indicate a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong housing starts and low unemployment, or the correlation between the interaction term and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP growth rate indicate an easing monetary cycle and a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with FEDFUNDS decrease and GDP growth increase, or the correlation between the interaction term and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate and a low unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with high employment and low unemployment, or the correlation between the interaction term and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales and a low unemployment rate indicate a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during an early-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong retail sales and low unemployment during an early-cycle expansion, or the correlation between the interaction term and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).
